title: Scaling Limits of Density Fluctuation Fields of the Symmetric Partial Exclusion Processes Approaching the Zero Range Process
summary: We study equilibrium fluctuations for the symmetric partial exclusion process (SPEP) on the one-dimensional integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}$, an interacting particle system in which each site is occupied by at most $α$ particles. We assume that the jump rate is decomposable and that the instantaneous current admits a gradient form. Our aim is to study the scaling limit of the density fluctuation field of the SPEP starting from an invariant measure and to derive the corresponding stochastic partial differential equation (SPDE).
